The test built its adapter-path probe with join("runtime", "pi") plus a hardcoded trailing "/", producing "runtime\pi/" on Windows, which never matches real all-backslash paths. Every src/runtime/pi file was therefore misclassified as outside the adapter and failed the @earendil-works import allowlist assertion (the error message names src/runtime/pi/credential-store.ts via the assertion's file argument). Reproduced locally under Node 22.19.0 (2 of 4 runs failed before the fix): listTransactionsInRange ordered by occurred_at, created_at, id — transactions recorded in the same millisecond tie on the first two keys, and the random UUID id made the tie-break order random.
